data.DiseaseDescription: A rare, pigmentary, and atrophic autosomal recessive disease. It is manifested as an extreme photosensitivity to ULTRAVIOLET RAYS as the result of a deficiency in the enzyme that permits excisional repair of ultraviolet-damaged DNA.
data.PathwayNames: Translesion synthesis by Y family DNA polymerases bypasses lesions on DNA template
